sup.title: My team today

sum.title: Summary
problems.title: Problem list
settings.title: Settings
settings.resetConfirm: This removes everything added during the demo and loads the starting data again. Reset now?
settings.resetDone: Demo data is back to the start.
settings.aboutText: This is a prototype to show the idea and test it with staff. It uses made-up demo data and keeps everything on this device. There is no real login and no link to other systems.
state.error: That didn't save. We'll try again when you're online.
start.title: Start a checklist
start.scanHint: Point the camera at the code on the wall.
start.cantScan: Camera not working? Pick the place from the list
start.unknownCode: This code isn't one of ours. Pick the place from the list instead.
start.noChecklist: There is no checklist for {place} yet.
scan.noCamera: The camera didn't open. Pick the place from the list instead.
scan.videoLabel: Camera view for scanning the code
pick.more: {n} more. Type to narrow the list.
pick.none: No place matches. Check the name or room number.
run.tapToTick: Tap a task when it's done. We'll ask for your initials once.
run.notReady: tick every task, or say why you could not do it
run.sentAt: Sent at {time}. Waiting for the supervisor's check.
ini.title: Your initials
ini.label: Initials (2 or 3 letters)
ini.hint: They show next to each task you tick, with the time.
cnd.label: Could not do
cnd.reason1: Item missing or out of stock
check.hint: Go and look at the place. Check the result, not the ticks.
check.noteLabel: What should they look at again?
check.notePlaceholder: For example: please check the drain again
photo.open: Tap to see it full screen
problems.pick: Pick a problem from the list to see it here.
filter.label: Filter the list
prob.interim: What we've done in the meantime
prob.capexNote: This is on the capex list. It stays visible but no longer counts as the team's open work.
prob.capexConfirm: This needs building work or new equipment, not more care from the team. It will stay on the list but leave the team's open count.
prob.fixIntro: Someone else will check it and confirm it's fixed.
prob.fixedDone: Marked as fixed. Waiting for someone to check.
block.self-fix: You fixed this, so someone else needs to check it and confirm. This keeps every fix checked by a second person.
block.role: A supervisor, manager or auditor confirms fixes.
block.team: Only someone from this area can confirm this fix.
hist.capex: {name} sent it to the capex list
new.whatPlaceholder: For example: algae on the drain grid
new.needWhat: Write a few words about the problem.
new.areaAuto: Old or renovated area is filled in from the place.
new.interimPlaceholder: For example: area roped off, sign put up
new.needInterim: Say what has been done to keep people safe for now.
new.fixFields: Some details are missing. Check the fields above.
hero.head: Open problems: {n} · Overdue: {o}
home.allDone: All your checklists are done for today. Thank you.
insp.twoTotalsNote: Two separate totals: how the work was done, and what it looks like. They are never added together.
sum.byArea: Open problems by area and kind
sum.byAreaHint: Old and renovated areas apart; condition and care apart. Tap a bar to see the list.
sum.repeatsHint: The same problem at the same place twice in 30 days.
qr.title: QR codes for every place
qr.hint: Print this page and put each code at its place. Staff scan it to start the right checklist.
qr.rooms: Rooms: one code per building is shown here; the real tool would print one per room.
lead.title: Leadership
lead.cadence.gm: Every morning, about 5 minutes: what needs a push today.
lead.cadence.ceo: A 1-minute glance each day for exceptions; the trend once a week.
lead.cadence.owner: Once a week. Daily only if there is an open safety problem.
lead.footnote: Weeks before this one are made-up demo history. This week comes from the app.
lead.checklistsLine: Checklists today: {done} done · {prog} in progress · {back} sent back
lead.exceptionsLine: Safety problems open more than 2 days, or overdue by more than a week
lead.trendTitle: Open and overdue problems, week by week
lead.trendHint: Open problems went from {from} to {to} over 9 weeks.
lead.inspTitle: Inspections: how the work is done, and how it looks
lead.inspCompare: Last week, compared with 8 weeks ago.
lead.inspThisWeek: This week so far ({runs} inspections): steps followed {s} in 10, result good {r} in 10.
lead.kindTitle: What kind of problems are open
lead.kindHint: Care problems the teams can fix. Condition problems often need repair or investment.
lead.ownerSafety: {n} safety problems open; the oldest for {d} days.
lead.ownerSafetyHint: The GM and the team are handling them. Each one has a note on what is done in the meantime.
lead.capexHint: Problems the team cannot fix with care alone: they need building work or new equipment. Only condition problems in old areas go here.
lead.areasHint: Open room problems for every 100 rooms, old areas and renovated areas apart.
lead.areasRead: Old areas still have more problems per room, and are slowly improving. Renovated areas are creeping up. If the two lines meet, renovations are wearing faster than expected.
lead.roadLine: In inspections, the result is good on {to} items in 10, up from {from} eight weeks ago.
lead.roadHint: Upper-upscale needs this close to 10 in 10, and to stay there.
hero.leadSafety: Safety problems open: {n}. The GM's team is on them.
hero.leadCalm: No open safety problems. Here is the week.
pick.typeRoom: Type a room number, for example 5212.
